rules: Welcome credits are one-time, not cash, apply only to the setup fee of ANOTHER VYNTEX service (website, branding, social media, etc.), expire in 90 days, require an active paid subscription, and cannot be combined. They can never be used on VYNTEX BUILD / VYNTEX CLEAN (setup, monthly fees or add-ons).
All usage (texts, calls, extra storage) is pass-through, never included.
Every item is a separate invoice line: subscription, setup, add-ons, usage.
1099 work is performed by Lion Business Services and requires the customer's written consent to share subcontractor payment data.
Do not turn on Stripe Tax until Daysi confirms the tax setup.

Automatic client emails are service emails only (no marketing). Fair use: up to 2,000 emails per company per month. Each company verifies its own sending domain (SPF/DKIM); until then, send from a VYNTEX address with the company name and reply-to set to the company email.
No 2.9% service fee line on VYNTEX BUILD or any industry edition: VYNTEX absorbs processing fees.
Payment methods: cards, Apple Pay/Google Pay and ACH bank debit (recommended for subscriptions). Klarna, Afterpay and Affirm stay turned off.
Plan names: VYNTEX BUILD = Foundation / Builder / Master Builder. Every other industry = Essential / Pro / Elite (Esencial / Pro / Élite).

other_industries.notes: Reusable plan names for every industry except VYNTEX BUILD (Foundation/Builder/Master Builder). Same prices, features, add-ons and rules as VYNTEX BUILD.
